newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta shares edge up at close, eyes on Alumindo.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta shares edge up at close, eyes on Alumindo.

text.p: Jakarta share prices edged up at the close in slow trading on Thursday, with the focus fixed on newly-listed light metal manufacturer Alumindo, brokers said.
The Jakarta composite index rose 0.67 points, or 0.11 percent, to 638.10 points after touching a high of 638.90 points. Decliners led advancers by 51 to 37, with 57 counters unchanged.

"The market is likely to remain slow in thin trading on Friday, as most players would still be on holiday. We expect the market to return to normal next Monday," one broker with a local brokerage said.
Brokers, however, said overall market sentiment was weak following sharp falls on Wall Street last Tuesday.

The Dow Jones industrial average fell 101.10 points to 6,448.27 on Tuesday after the bond market absorbed a body blow from a pair of reports that pointed to faster economic growth next year that might signal a pickup in inflation.
Brokers said the focus remained on light metal manufacturer Alumindo, which debuted today.
Alumindo ended 100 rupiah higher at 1,400 rupiah after rising to a high of 1,425 rupiah, with volume close to ten million shares.
Brokers said sentiment was initially cautious on Alumindo as they had expected the light metal manufacturer to perfom as poorly as Sierad Produce.
They, however, said some support from the company and its underwriters were seen keeping Alumindo hovering above its initial offer price of 1,300 rupiah.
Sierad Produce was the second most actively traded after Alumindo. It rebounded 50 rupiah to 875 rupiah, with around nine million shares traded.
Telkom ended 25 rupiah higher to 4,100 rupiah on reports of the government's decision to revise telephone tariffs, brokers said.
The government announced on Monday it planned to raise tariffs for local telephone calls, while lower the cost of regional and international calls from January 1.
